calls.statement:
WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id, valid_from) AS ties
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT count(*) AS members, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ties>1) AS tie_members,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE valid_from <> join_date) AS from_ne_join,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store)) AS unknown_home
FROM fv WHERE rn=1
SELECT min(calendar_date), max(calendar_date), fiscal_year FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26') GROUP BY 3

SELECT 'multi_join_date' AS chk, count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT join_date)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'store_ids_with_not_1_current', count(*) FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current)<>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'members_joined_FY2526', count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
UNION ALL SELECT 'first_version_home_ne_any_later', count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT home_store_id)>1)

WITH first_version AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS version_no
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT fv.home_store_id AS store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, cs.format, cs.close_date, COUNT(*) AS new_members
FROM first_version fv
LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE fv.version_no = 1
  AND fv.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS rn
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.open_date, s.close_date, count(*) AS joins_fy,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE fv.join_date < s.open_date) AS before_open,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE fv.join_date > s.close_date) AS after_close,
  min(fv.join_date) AS first_join, max(fv.join_date) AS last_join
FROM fv JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=fv.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE fv.rn=1 AND fv.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
  AND (s.open_date IS NOT NULL OR s.close_date IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1
